title: Integral open compact support vanishes across an empty pullback
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite coefficient extension E/Q_ell, a field k with ell invertible, finite-type k-schemes U and X, a quasi-compact open k-immersion j:U→X, and i:Z→X. Assume ell invertible in the residue fields of X and Z and U×_X Z empty. For every integral constructible K on U, the specified constructible integral pullback of the fixed compact-support functor for (j,id_X) is a zero object. The operations are those of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom; def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support; def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed].

proof.text: For (j,id), the defining compact-support strict tower is extension of the input reduction tower. The specified open-reduction comparison identifies its total limit with ringed-site extension, including every quotient transition.

The integral/completed pullback comparison supplies intrinsic completeness of the constructible input and identifies its pullback with completed pullback. Apply completed open base change; its map is invertible.

Every module sheaf on the empty pullback is zero by the empty covering axiom. In the direct-sum extension formula every summand is zero, so the extension presheaf and its sheafification are zero. This remains zero termwise and after derived localization. Thus the target of completed exchange is zero. Transport its zero-object property through the comparisons of the previous steps.

lean.statement:
theorem integralOpenEmptyPullbackVanishing
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hl : IsUnit (l : k))
    {U X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [U.Over (Spec (.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsEmpty ↥(pullback j i : Scheme.{u})]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E U) :
    IsZero ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E i).obj
      ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l k hl
        (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j) E).obj K))
